_note: Candidate registry for Rhode Island 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Rhode Island Department of State, Elections Division, Declared Candidates Report (Excel, last modified July 30, 2026), with Rhode Island Board of Elections, Summary Results Report, Official Results, Primary Election September 9, 2026 (dated 09/16/2026), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Rhode Island Department of State, Elections Division, Declared Candidates Report (Excel, last modified July 30, 2026), with Rhode Island Board of Elections, Summary Results Report, Official Results, Primary Election September 9, 2026 (dated 09/16/2026) (https://vote.sos.ri.gov/Forms/elections/Reports/Candidates.xlsx); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
